This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
None appears for the informant.
Learned counsel for the petitioner files the certified copies of the depositions of the witnesses, which are taken on record.

This is an application for bail under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Narasinghpur P.S.
Case No. 15 of 2021 corresponding to Spl. G.R. Case No. 18 of 2021 pending in the file of learned Addl. Sessions Judge -cum- Special Court under POCSO Act, Cuttack // 2 // for alleged commission of offences under sections 363/294/506/366/376(2)(n)/376(3)/354-D/509/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with sections 6 and 17 Act.
The bail application of the petitioner was rejected by the learned Addl. Sessions Judge -cum- Special Court under POCSO Act, Cuttack vide order dated 16.01.2023.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is in judicial custody since 27.01.2021 and he has been charge sheeted under sections 363/294/506/366/
376(2)(n)/376(3)/354-D/509/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with sections 6 and 17 Act and after going through the evidence of the victim, who has been examined as P.W.5 in the learned trial Court, I am inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
Let the petitioner be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing bail bond of Rs.50,000/-
(rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter with such terms and conditions as the learned Court may deem just and proper including the conditions that the petitioner shall not indulge in any criminal activities, shall appear before the learned trial Court when the // 3 // case would be posted for trial and shall not try to tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
